content: DMTools (EPAM, Apache 2.0) is a CLI orchestrator running AI agents inside enterprise delivery systems: 320+ tools, 20+ integrations (Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Confluence, Figma, Teams). Installs fresh each run, no server/daemon, runs in your CI or machine under your credentials against your chosen AI provider; reusable jobs/agents for analysis, test-gen, reporting, teammate workflows; emphasises repeatable, auditable automation.
